state.objective: Reduce this client's chart of accounts by moving asset identity and operational detail into dimensions while preserving distinct accounting natures and the full legacy COA mapping.
confirmed_context: Client is a centralized retail company. Unit/site has already been removed from the natural account and is stored as site_id.
Working family baseline before bank compression is 499. The current bank proposal reduces this to 488; this arithmetic is calculated outside Jev.
Only client account names listed here are in scope. Do not invent foreign currency, overdraft, pledged deposits, or other accounts.

The asset register can hold asset_id, asset_class_id, associated_site_id, acquisition date, cost, useful life, residual value, depreciation method, accumulated depreciation, status, disposal date, and project/CIP reference.
Moving detail to a register does not permit netting asset cost, accumulated depreciation, depreciation expense, amortization, CIP, or disposal into one natural account.

cost_57.operating_equipment_36: 36 named OE items such as rack/display/hanger/mannequin items

client_asset_families.accumulated_20: Accumulated depreciation/amortization counterparts for HGB, 3 buildings, M&E, 4 machines, 2 vehicles, 7 FFE classes, and 2 software applications. There are no accumulated depreciation accounts for the 36 OE items.
client_asset_families.expense_20: Depreciation expense for 3 buildings, M&E, 4 machines, 2 vehicles, 7 FFE; amortization expense for SeventhSoft, Pre Opening, and OptiTex.
unresolved: 36 Reserve Replacement OE accounts, one for each named OE item
Pre Opening and Akumulasi Amortisasi Pre Opening
Hak Sewa Tanah / HGB and its accumulated amortization/depreciation account

asset_identity_dimension.instructions: Should individual physical asset identity and associated site be removed from natural GL accounts when a controlled asset register supports subledger-to-GL reconciliation?

criteria.yes: Use asset_id and associated_site_id in the asset register; GL keeps accounting nature/class only.
criteria.no: Keep each individual asset or site as a natural GL account.
criteria.insufficient: The stated controls are insufficient even as a conditional target design.

cost_class_granularity.instructions: For the 57 acquisition-cost families, what is the safest target granularity supported by the names alone?

criteria.one_fixed_asset: One fixed-asset-cost GL for all 57 families.
criteria.broad_classes: Keep broad accounting classes such as land, land rights, buildings, M&E/machinery, vehicles, FFE/OE, and software; item identity sits in asset_class_id/asset_id.
criteria.all_57: Retain every current named cost family as a GL.
criteria.insufficient: No target granularity can be proposed from these names.

oe_item_names.instructions: Can the 36 OE item names be moved from separate acquisition-cost GLs into asset_class_id/item type, subject to a common accounting policy and useful-life treatment?

criteria.merge: One or a small number of OE cost GLs plus asset class/item detail.

ffe_names.instructions: Can the seven FFE names be represented as asset classes beneath fewer natural cost GLs if reporting and useful-life policies are aligned?

criteria.merge: Compress to fewer FFE cost GLs with asset_class_id.

contra_separation.instructions: Must accumulated depreciation remain a separate natural-account nature from asset acquisition cost even when both use the same asset_class_id?

criteria.separate: Separate cost and accumulated depreciation natural accounts.

expense_separation.instructions: Must depreciation/amortization expense remain separate from balance-sheet cost and accumulated depreciation accounts?

criteria.separate: Keep expense as a distinct natural-account nature.
criteria.combine: Combine expense with accumulated depreciation or asset cost.

expense_class_detail.instructions: Where cost and accumulated depreciation are compressed by broad class, can depreciation expense use the same broad asset_class_id rather than retaining every named asset type as a natural GL?

criteria.yes: Use fewer expense GLs plus asset_class_id.
criteria.review: Conditional on management-reporting requirements and policy.

land.instructions: Should Tanah Hak Milik remain its own non-depreciable natural asset class rather than merge into depreciable buildings or equipment?

criteria.separate: Retain separate land cost natural account.
criteria.merge: Merge land into another depreciable class.

hgb.instructions: Can Hak Sewa Tanah / HGB be assigned conclusively to a target natural account from its name and current accumulated amortization/depreciation account alone?

criteria.no: Review legal rights, term, renewal, ownership and accounting policy before classifying.
criteria.intangible: Treat as an intangible/right account immediately.
criteria.rou: Treat as a lease right-of-use asset immediately.

cip.instructions: Should Contract In Progress remain a separate natural-account nature until completion and capitalization, even if project_id is used?

criteria.separate: Retain CIP separately; project detail is dimensional.
criteria.merge: Merge directly into completed fixed assets.
criteria.review: Name is insufficient to know whether this is CIP.

preopening.instructions: Can Pre Opening, Akumulasi Amortisasi Pre Opening, and its amortization expense be retained as a valid amortizable asset structure solely from these account names?

criteria.no: Require capitalization policy and transaction review; names alone do not validate an asset.
criteria.yes: Retain as an amortizable asset without more evidence.
criteria.expense: Reclassify all balances immediately to expense solely from the names.

reserve_oe.instructions: Can the 36 Reserve Replacement OE accounts be classified or compressed solely because they repeat the 36 OE item names?

criteria.no: First determine whether each is a contra asset, provision, internal reserve, or expense/accrual mechanism.
criteria.one_reserve: Compress all 36 immediately into one reserve GL.
criteria.accumulated_depreciation: Treat all 36 immediately as accumulated depreciation.

disposed_inventory.instructions: Should Disposed Inventory be included automatically in the fixed-asset compression merely because it contains the word disposed?

criteria.no: Keep outside fixed-asset scope until transaction nature is verified.
criteria.yes: Treat it as fixed-asset disposal now.
criteria.merge_oe: Merge it into OE asset cost.

minimum_controls.instructions: What is the minimum safe migration gate for compressing asset-name GLs?

criteria.register_reconciliation: Complete asset register, opening-balance mapping, class policy/useful lives, and subledger-to-GL reconciliation.
criteria.jev_votes: Repeated model answers are sufficient without accounting evidence.
